96% of developers don't fully trust AI-written code. Barely half ever check it before they commit.

Here's a 90-second look at forge-harness — where your tests, not the agent, decide what's done. 🧵

Watch forge's real dashboard. A story hits Retry: a check failed, and the board shows you exactly which one.

Fix it, re-run, and it slides to Done carrying its evidence. Same inputs, same verdict, every run.

Under the hood: 8 building blocks, and only one ever calls the model — the planner. The other seven are plain code running your shell commands as the pass/fail checks.

No agent grading its own homework.

The whole loop — plan, build, verdict — and on a Max plan that's $0 out of pocket.

Open-source, MIT. Your tests decide what ships.
